reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute ticket volume has sustained roughly double its pre-August baseline since August 2026 (610-590/month Jun-Jul vs 1180-1260/month Aug-Sep, E-06), and 59% of disputed bills (1785/3025) carry an ACTUAL read type rather than ESTIMATED (E-02) — indicating the surge is driven primarily by a billing-calculation defect that produces incorrect bills even on accounts with a valid read, not by read-availability/estimate substitution. Tariff changes did not occur in the period (E-03), ruling out tariff adjustment as that defect, while the specific calculation mechanism (e.g. an import validation rule change) is not yet confirmed by evidence.
